audit.why: Content early/mid/late already correctly identify Nami favored levels 1-2 (Xerath's immobility), Xerath favored from level 3 through late game on siege range.
Spikes array correctly identifies level-2 all-in on his immobility, level-6 three-shot R execute range, first-item poke crossover, and late-game turret status.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart mismatch: full phases[N].side disagrees with content win[N] (which matches packet.levelChart) on all 7 rows — rows 0-1 say Xerath when win says Nami, rows 2-6 use the placeholder 'Skill' when win says Xerath.
audit.why: content win[] already matches packet.levelChart. full phases[N].side and several why texts were never updated to match — the whys were templated rather than grounded in real cooldowns (Shocking Orb E 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s CD, R 130/115/100s).
audit.corrected: Set full phases[N].side to match content win[N] for all 7 rows, rewriting why text to state the grounded reason for each side.

edits.before: W-bounce the trades — the heal-damage bounce wins every honest level 1 exchange.
edits.after: Xerath is immobile early — Bubble threat and E-buffed trades win level 1 clean.

edits.before: Bubble threats begin: the lane's longest stun re-prices their every step-up.
edits.after: Hitting 2 first with E-buffed autos plus Bubble wins the all-in he can't escape.

edits.before: Full kit: E the carry's autos and the buffed trade window out-damages their plan.
edits.after: At 3 his Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction poke out-range your auto-empowered trades.

edits.before: Tide the margins: bounce the trades, bubble the answers, and bank the tempo passive.
edits.after: His artillery poke and Shocking Orb stun now out-siege your sustain and engage.

edits.before: Tidal Wave online — engages arrive on a wave and disengages leave on one.
edits.after: His three-shot R zones and executes your backline from off-screen range.

edits.before: First item: the bounce chunks and the bubble converts every gank.
edits.after: First item pushes his poke DPS well past your heal throughput.

edits.before: Late Nami conducts: wave the engage, bubble the peel, and E whoever's swinging.
edits.after: He's a full artillery turret out-ranging everything; only a warded flank punishes him.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Aqua Prison answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Xerath E (Shocking Orb): 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s CD — his only hard CC. Dodge it and the artillery combo never converts, so read it before every duo step-up. - His R is 130/115/100s — spend your Q Aqua Prison on the swing moment, not on chip.

edits.before: W the bounce through carry-and-support, E your carry, auto — the trade healed you, billed them, and buffed the follow-up.
edits.after: Shocking Orb is a single skillshot on an 11-13s CD — weave through minions and it whiffs, denying his whole combo.

edits.before: Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: Standing in Arcanopulse/Eye of Destruction range to poke back invites the stun that starts his combo.

notes: phases[6].rating stayed 6/10 despite the side moving to Xerath — left as-is since rating reflects lane difficulty/threat rather than which side, and the packet gives no separate late-game rating signal to correct it against.
